ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "Mapping Latino/a Inequalities." Explores contemporary structural forces that contribute to the concentration of Latino/as in segregated neighborhoods, and the detrimental effects of housing inequality on Latino/a communities. The focus will be on mapping the countours of institutional discrimination as they affect urban, semi-urban, and rural landscapes. Topics to be discussed include: housing access, environmental racism, educational disparities, crime, police brutality, community activism, and cultural production. We will further examine the role of space and place in the development and persistence of community identities.
